estimates.assumptions: A thumb-sized piece of peeled ginger is typically 12-18g; using 15g as a realistic average for a standard thumb.
2 tbsp of curry paste (e.g., Madras) weighs ~30g (15g per tbsp for thick paste); ~250 kcal/100g is a typical value for commercial Indian curry pastes based on oil, spices, and tomatoes.
One standard cinnamon stick weighs ~2-4g; using 3g as average. Known calories copied exactly.
6 cardamom pods (bashed) weigh ~3-5g total; using 4g as realistic. Known calories copied exactly.
4 whole cloves weigh ~1-2.5g total; using 2g as average. Known calories copied exactly.
2 bay leaves weigh ~0.5-1.5g total; using 1g as realistic. Known calories copied exactly.
1kg cubed lamb is taken as 1000g of lean-to-moderately-fat raw boneless lamb shoulder/leg (common for rogan josh); ~250 kcal/100g is typical for such cuts in raw cubed state.
150ml Greek yogurt weighs ~150g (density ~1g/ml). Known grams and calories copied exactly.
Chopped coriander as garnish for the full recipe is a modest 8-15g bunch portion; using 10g. Known calories copied exactly.
